name: Intune Enrollment or Application Deployment Failure
checks: Determine whether the failure is enrollment, assignment, detection, installation, or remediation.
Confirm the affected user/device is actually targeted by the intended assignment.
Inspect the relevant Intune status/error and local management extension logs.
Only then modify detection rules, install context, remediation, allowlists or package configuration.
stop_condition: Stop when the failure stage and its concrete error/evidence are identified.
resolution: Correct the specific targeting, detection, installation or remediation fault rather than rebuilding the whole deployment.
